transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I've been struggling with my eating lately. I keep having these episodes where I eat an unusually large amount of food, and I feel like I completely lose control over my eating when it happens.
After these episodes, do you ever try to prevent weight gain by making yourself vomit, using laxatives, fasting, or exercising excessively?
No, I don't do any of those things. I've never forced myself to throw up, used laxatives, or tried to fast or over-exercise afterwards.
How often do these eating episodes happen, and for how long have they been going on?
They have been happening for about two years and three months now. On average, I would say these episodes occur at least once a week.

During these episodes, do you usually eat much more rapidly than normal, eat until you feel uncomfortably full, eat when you’re not physically hungry, eat alone because you feel embarrassed, or feel disgusted, depressed, or very guilty afterward?

I definitely eat much faster than normal during these episodes, and I keep going until I'm uncomfortably full, even if I wasn't actually hungry. I'm not really sure about the other things though—I don't think I really experience eating alone out of embarrassment or feeling disgusted and guilty afterward.
Do these binge-eating episodes cause you significant distress or upset?
I'm not entirely sure, to be honest. I haven't really thought about how to describe my feelings regarding the episodes, other than just wanting to get the eating itself under control.
Do these episodes feel upsetting or troubling to you, or do you mainly see them as a habit you want to change?

I'm not quite sure how to describe it, and I haven't really thought about it in those exact terms. I just know it's something I want to stop doing, but I can't really say if I find it deeply upsetting or just a bad habit.
Have these eating episodes been causing problems in your daily life, like affecting your mood, work, relationships, or making you avoid certain situations?

I'm not really sure, to be honest. I haven't really thought about how these episodes affect my work, relationships, or daily life. I've mostly just been focused on the eating itself and trying to figure out how to stop.
How much do your weight or body shape affect how you feel about yourself?

Honestly, I haven't really thought about that much. My weight or body shape doesn't seem to be the main issue I'm focusing on right now; I'm just really trying to get this eating behavior under control.
When these episodes happen, does it feel like you truly can’t stop eating or control what or how much you’re eating?

Yes, that's exactly what it feels like. Once an episode starts, I feel a complete lack of control, as if I physically cannot stop myself from eating. I just can't seem to control how much or what I'm consuming in those moments.
About how long does a typical eating episode last?
I'm not entirely sure of the exact amount of time they last. I tend to lose track of time during these episodes, so I don't really pay attention to the clock.
